factErrors: code.map.cpp: pseudocode line 5 '(xong u: quay lui)' is mapped to C++ lines 5-6, but line 5 is '}' closing the for loop and line 6 is '}' closing the function; the backtrack is implicit in the function return, so the map is wrong (py map '5':[6] is acceptable since line 6 is the recursive call whose return is the backtrack)

code.map.py: pseudocode line 2 'đánh dấu u đã thăm; order[u] ← ++timer' is mapped to py lines 2-3, but the marking is done by order[u] = timer[0] on line 3; line 2 only increments the timer, so the mapping is misleading

pitfalls[1] (iterative stack must push neighbours in reverse order to match the recursive order): this is false in general — pushing neighbours in reverse order makes the iterative stack visit them in the same order as the recursive version only when the stack is used as a plain LIFO without re-pushing; the claim as stated is not a correct invariant and is attached to the wrong beat (tree-edge instead of a stack-specific beat)

script 'tree' and 'cycle' and 'deep-chain': the narration jumps from frame 10 to the final frame (27/25/31) without narrating the intermediate backtracking steps, so the 'done' narration ('DFS thăm 7 đỉnh qua 6 cạnh cây') is spoken while the displayed frame is the final one but the preceding frames were never shown; the scripted lesson is truncated and the jump skips the backtracking beats that the 'done' narration depends on

issues.problem: The explanation says 'Call stack có 1 đỉnh' / 'holds 1 nodes' — the English is grammatically wrong ('1 nodes') and the Vietnamese 'có 1 đỉnh' is ambiguous (could read as 'has 1 node' vs 'the stack has 1 node').
issues.fix: Use 'Call stack has 1 node' / 'Call stack có 1 đỉnh' consistently, and for plural use 'nodes'/'đỉnh' correctly.

issues.where: beats[].narration for 'visit' (e.g. 'Thăm {u}: ... đưa {u} lên call stack (đang có {size} đỉnh)')
issues.problem: The narration says the node is pushed onto the call stack, but the frame's aux stack already includes the node at the moment of the visit; the narration and the frame are consistent, but the phrase 'đang có {size} đỉnh' is read after the push, which may confuse students about whether the count includes the current node.
issues.fix: Clarify: 'sau khi đưa {u} lên, call stack có {size} đỉnh'.
